relationship.statement: A simple pendulum's swing time (period) increases with string length and decreases with stronger gravity, while the bob's mass does not affect it. For small swings, release angle changes the swing's width and speed, not its period.
assumptions: The bob acts as a point mass on a massless, rigid rod.
Air resistance and pivot friction are neglected.
Release angles stay small so the small-angle rule holds.

quantities.label: String length
quantities.meaning: Distance from the pivot point to the center of the hanging bob.

quantities.label: Bob mass
quantities.meaning: Mass of the pendulum bob; gravity pulls harder on heavier bobs, but inertia resists equally.

quantities.label: Gravity
quantities.meaning: Gravitational acceleration pulling the pendulum back toward vertical.

quantities.label: Release angle
quantities.meaning: Starting angle from vertical, setting the swing's width and peak speed.

quantities.label: Period
quantities.meaning: Time required for one complete back-and-forth swing.

quantities.label: Frequency
quantities.meaning: Number of complete back-and-forth swings per second.

quantities.label: Peak speed
quantities.meaning: Maximum speed of the bob at the bottom of the swing.

math.code: function compute(inputs, t) { const L = inputs.L; const theta0 = inputs.theta0; const g = 9.81; const T = 2 * Math.PI * Math.sqrt(L / g); const f = 1 / T; const theta0_rad = theta0 * Math.PI / 180; const omega = Math.sqrt(g / L); const theta_rad = theta0_rad * Math.cos(omega * t); const theta = theta0 * Math.cos(omega * t); const x = L * Math.sin(theta_rad); const y = -L * Math.cos(theta_rad); const v_max = theta0_rad * Math.sqrt(g * L); const v_tan = -v_max * Math.sin(omega * t); const vx_tip = x + 0.35 * v_tan * Math.cos(theta_rad); const vy_tip = y + 0.35 * v_tan * Math.sin(theta_rad); const L_ref = 1.0; const theta0_ref = 15; const theta0_ref_rad = theta0_ref * Math.PI / 180; const omega_ref = Math.sqrt(g / L_ref); const theta_ref_rad = theta0_ref_rad * Math.cos(omega_ref * t); const theta_ref = theta0_ref * Math.cos(omega_ref * t); const x_ref = L_ref * Math.sin(theta_ref_rad); const y_ref = -L_ref * Math.cos(theta_ref_rad); return { T: T, f: f, v_max: v_max, theta: theta, theta_ref: theta_ref, x: x, y: y, vx_tip: vx_tip, vy_tip: vy_tip, x_ref: x_ref, y_ref: y_ref, is_longer: L > 1.05, is_shorter: L < 0.95, is_wider: theta0 > 15 }; }

lesson.title: What changes a pendulum swing?
lesson.description: Compare your pendulum against a fixed 1 m, 15 deg reference to see what changes its period and speed. Adjust string length and release angle while mass and gravity stay fixed.
lesson.instructions: Move String length to see how length alters both the swing period and peak speed. Move Release angle to widen the swing and boost peak speed, then check the Angle graph to confirm the period stays aligned with the same length.
lesson.goal: String length and gravity set a pendulum's period, while release angle changes only its swing width and peak speed.
